headlines.title: Thousands of migrants force their way into Spain’s African territory
headlines.description: Border guards in the tiny Spanish exclave of Ceuta on the Moroccan coast were overwhelmed as crowds of young men pushed through gates and swam around the border barrier, hoping to gain entry into Europe.

headlines.title: Trump questioned about 'anti-weaponization' fund during Cabinet meeting at Camp David
headlines.description: President Trump said that the "anti-weaponization" fund set up after a settlement with the IRS was "dead" when questioned about it at a Cabinet meeting. NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez reports on what the president had to say about the fund and holdouts over acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination.

headlines.title: Trump calls Minnesota 'grossly incompetent' after water system cyberattack
headlines.description: President Trump said he did not believe Iran was behind a cyberattack on Minnesota's water systems, instead casting blame onto the state's government.

headlines.title: Mother fights to have post-pregnancy complication treated
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports on the Oregon mother who had to fight for approval to treat the near constant pain she was in due to a common complication many women face following pregnancy.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Tony Romo ‘on leave’ from CBS Sports after arrest on suspicion of impaired driving in Wisconsin
headlines.description: CBS football analyst and former NFL quarterback Tony Romo is “on leave,” the network said Friday, a week after he was arrested in Milwaukee on suspicion of impaired driving.

headlines.title: Sean Grayson, officer who shot Sonya Massey, denied medical release from 20-year prison sentence
headlines.description: Sean Grayson, the man who fatally shot Sonya Massey in her home in 2024, has been denied medical release by the Illinois Prisoner Review Board, a board spokesperson said Friday.

headlines.title: Father faces new charges after kidnapping two Forest Service workers with his son
headlines.description: A federal grand jury indicted a father and son in the kidnapping of two U.S. Forest Service employees who were held hostage in Northern California.

headlines.title: Hackers targeted municipal water systems in 7 states this week, FBI says
headlines.description: Cyberattacks targeting municipal water systems have been reported in at least seven states this week, prompting the FBI and the Environmental Protection Agency to warn utilities nationwide that hackers are trying to disrupt critical water infrastructure.

headlines.title: TSA discovers five stolen Civil War-era cannonballs in a traveler’s luggage in Alabama
headlines.description: TSA officers got quite the surprise at Alabama’s Gulf Shores International Airport (JKA) when they discovered a passenger trying to carry “a stolen historic relic” in their checked luggage — Civil War-era cannonballs wrapped in paper towels.

headlines.title: 50,000 cross into Spanish territory in deadly border rush
headlines.description: Spain was scrambling Friday to contain a sudden border crisis after tens of thousands of people rushed into its North African territory, with dozens killed and political shock waves spreading across Europe.

headlines.title: Men detained in Guthrie investigation file notice of claim against Pima County sheriff
headlines.description: The notice comes more than five months after Carlos Palazuelos and Daniel Maddox were detained for several hours in the search for Nancy Guthrie’s kidnapper.
